cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Ready on My Terms
cards.instruction: Agree to be honest, hopeful, or vulnerable only in forms that preserve your emotional safety.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'll sit by the door while we talk about trying again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Knowing I can leave is helping me stay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We can stop when you need to.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I want to come home. Please don't hand me a key yet; saying it is enough for tonight.
